about: Process plan for NIST FTC-09 on the shop's Haas VF-2, the sheet clamped to its table: it takes nist-ctc-01's place in G1 (your decision, 2026-11-04). It is an 11 ga stainless sheet, 279.4 x 190.5 x 3.04 mm, which the plan doc routes through the sheet laser; that station isn't built, so every hole, slot, the window and the outline are milled. A 3 mm sheet can't be held by its edges in a vise while its outline is cut, so it sits on a spoilboard under step clamps on its margin, and the outline leaves tabs. Written by Claude from the drawing (nist_ftc_09_asme1_rd) and the STEP model; every feature below is checked against the model by moonshot/planning/validate.py. Model frame: Y is thickness (the Y=0 face is datum A, the bottom; the lettering is engraved into the top), X is width (190.5, centred), Z is length (279.4, centred).

stock.material: 304 stainless steel sheet, 11 ga (.1195 thick), ASTM A240
stock.material_note: As the drawing; its two faces left as bought
stock.from: 11 ga sheet sheared to 10 x 13-1/2 in by the supplier

workholding.note: On a 3/4 in MDF spoilboard bolted to the table, which the through cuts run into; six step clamps on the sheet's 32 mm margin, clear of the outline's cutter path. The outline leaves four 1 mm tabs so the part stays put; they're cut at the bench

wcs.x: the centre of the sheet's length
wcs.by: probe in X, Y and Z; tool setter for the tools' lengths

operations.what: Drill 4X Ø.234 ±.008, and the six holes to be reamed
operations.note: 6 mm is .2362, inside the ±.008, and leaves the reamer .014

operations.what: Plunge the four Ø.250 ±.008 holes and mill the two Ø.315 [8 ±0.2] and the Ø.750 ±.008
Mill the three slots, the keyhole's Ø.375 and the window with its four scallops
Engrave the lettering 1.2 mm deep, as the model has it
Chamfer the four Ø.234 holes .03 x .03
Profile the 11.00 x 7.50 outline with its corners and notches, leaving four tabs

finish.title: Cut the tabs and deburr
finish.what: Cut the four tabs and file them flush, then deburr every edge and hole with a hooked blade drawn along it, so the sheet is safe to handle

finish.title: Check the holes, slots and flatness
finish.what: Check the 11.00 x 7.50 outline with the long calipers, the six reamed Ø.250 holes with gauge pins, the other holes and slots with the calipers, and the .01 flatness to A on the granite plate with the indicator
